# Psalm 14 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 14:4 (overlap: 6%)

- **EMET:** Do-they-not know, all workers-of iniquity, who-eat my-people [as] they-eat bread? YHWH they-do-not call-upon.
- **LOGOS:** Have they no knowledge, all the evildoers who eat up my people as they eat bread, and do not call upon the LORD?
- **PNEUMA:** Will these evildoers never learn? They devour my people the way they devour bread. They refuse to pray to the LORD.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. Of David. The fool says in his heart, 'There is no God.' They are corrupt; they do abominable deeds; there is none who does good.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. A psalm of David. Only fools say in their hearts, 'There is no God.' They are corrupt; their actions are evil. Not one of them does good.
